context: Yesterday is a hole, not a downturn: the Claude CLI OAuth session expired mid-day 2026-09-19 and four of five cycles aborted at Stage 1 in roughly 25 seconds each, so 09-19 published 13 articles from one cycle instead of the usual ~60. Auth was restored before today's 04:00 cycle and all five of today's cycles completed normally, so no action is needed beyond knowing that any day-over-day comparison against 09-19 is meaningless. The recurrence risk is real, though — OAuth tokens in ~/.claude/.credentials.json need periodic interactive re-auth, and the failure mode is silent at the cycle level, costing a full day of output before anyone looks. Token cost is unchanged by the active experiment: cycle logs 09-16 through 09-20 all show articles=4x1, confirming the widened gap-country list is one call whatever its length.
